items.item_text: Experience providing analytical and administrative support that includes, but not limited to, conducting research, interpreting data, providing comparative reports, statistical analyses and historical summaries using computerized systems including Microsoft Office, web based applications and databases.
Experience developing creative solutions to general problems, attempting unfamiliar projects/assignments and respond with flexibility to requests for assistance.
Experience with the conversion of documents, developing presentations, and utilizing audio/visual and teleconferencing technology for projection during meetings.
Skills to synthesize complex issues and record the essence and intent of committee actions. Experience contributing to a team environment.
Experience working in an executive-level office environment handling and/or advising others on sensitive/confidential information and situations diplomatically.

Under general supervision of the Associate Director, provide analytical and administrative support to multiple committees of the Academic Senate and Academic Federation. Counsel committee chairs, members and campus community on policies and procedures.
50% - Research And Operational Analytical Support To Academic Senate And Academic Federation Standing Committees

Communicate campus and Senate/Federation policies and procedures and their impact to faculty and staff. Ensure committee compliance with campus and systemwide policies and practices. Participate in committee deliberations to (1) define/recommend courses of action on policy reviews/ development. Make judgments, decisions, and recommendations that impact campus operations. Conduct research, analyze data, and provide comparative reports, statistical analyses and historical summaries. Develop operational procedures.

Recommend establishment or revision of existing campus and committee policies and procedures. Committee assignments and support are subject to change to accommodate analyst cross-training, exposure to multiple committees, succession planning, and to meet office business needs. #CA-AR
Interpersonal skills (oral and written) to communicate professionally and collaboratively; ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds.

Skills to interpret and apply principles and bylaws governing the Davis Division of the Academic Senate and Systemwide Academic Senate, in order to provide accurate information to Academic Senate leadership, chairs, committees, faculty, and academic/administrative departments.
Ability to facilitate meetings, processes and developing consensus amongst a group.
Writing, editing and proofreading skills to compose clear, concise and grammatically correct documents and communication.
Organizational skills to work on multiple projects and unexpected job demands with competing deadlines and changing priorities with both urgency and flexibility while maintaining productivity.
